purpose: Validation-only paired screen of one sparse official traffic-graph propagation before the fast MambaTSv3 temporal scan, with AutoCon retained in both candidate arms.
research_question: Does an aligned directed sensor graph improve the failed METR-LA MambaTSv3 AutoCon route without sacrificing PEMS-BAY, and is any gain distinguishable from graph propagation alone?
evidence_boundary: All jobs use skip_test=true. No held-out test metrics are generated, read, or used for selection.
claim_boundary: This is a local graph-Mamba candidate and local GraphDLinear baseline, not an official reproduction of DCRNN, Graph WaveNet, or any public graph-Mamba repository. It cannot establish publication readiness or a general accuracy/speed claim.
prelaunch_gates: verify speed CSV hashes, graph NPZ hashes, and CSV-to-sensor order contracts
freeze the exact graph-off/on contrast and graph-only baseline before any training
require exact paired validation coverage and report iTransformer latency even if the candidate is slower

phases.name: mambatsv3_autocon_graph_off_h12
phases.purpose: Frozen AutoCon MambaTSv3 control without graph propagation.

phases.name: mambatsv3_autocon_graph_on_h12
phases.purpose: One-factor treatment: a single row-normalized directed sparse graph propagation before the same v3 temporal scan and the same AutoCon representation head.

phases.name: graphdlinear_h12
phases.purpose: Graph-only local baseline: the same graph propagation and DLinear temporal heads, without Mamba or AutoCon.

phases.name: external_context_h12
phases.purpose: Same-budget non-graph references; descriptive validation context only.

pairing_contract.interpretation: The off/on contrast isolates graph propagation within the same MambaTSv3+AutoCon model. GraphDLinear separately identifies whether a result is plausibly due to topology alone.

comparison_contract.publication_claim_boundary: Validation-only candidate screen; no held-out test or publication claim.

accuracy_gate.graph_vs_control: Treatment mean validation MSE must improve by at least 1.0% on both METR-LA and PEMS-BAY, win at least 2/3 paired seeds on each dataset, and have no paired degradation above 2.0%.
accuracy_gate.topology_attribution: GraphDLinear and Graph-Mamba must both be reported. Only Graph-Mamba may proceed, and only if its mean MSE is no worse than GraphDLinear and MambaTSv3 AutoCon control on both datasets.
accuracy_gate.external_context: Treatment must be within 2.0% validation MSE of the best external-context model on each dataset before a held-out replication is registered.
accuracy_gate.resource_gate: Use the exact graph preflight. Report the iTransformer comparison explicitly; current graph-Mamba may only claim to be faster than PatchTST and TimeMixer, not uniformly fastest.
